glossary.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
glossary.role: Race/faction of giant humanoid warriors; main antagonists.
The military of Emperor Poseidal that rules the Pentagona World; the main antagonist force of L-Gaim.

glossary.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
glossary.role: U.N. Spacy VF-1 variable fighter series.

glossary.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
glossary.role: Skull Squadron leader, veteran ace VF-1S pilot and Hikaru's senpai/mentor.
glossary.personality: Brave, easygoing 'man's man' and ladies' man; rough exterior hiding compassion and humor even in grim situations.

glossary.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
glossary.role: Space-jump (fold) drive of the Macross; Nadesico gets caught in the Macross space fold.

Emperor ruling the Pentagona World from Sveto on Gastogal; supreme commander of the Poseidal Army. The Poseidal on the throne is actually Mian Qu Ha Ussher, a puppet of the true Poseidal (Amandara Kamandara). In ACE2 'Poseidal' is the pilot of the Aug.
glossary.personality: Regal, cold and imperious ruler who controls others (e.g. Quwasan) through the bio-relation system; her memories are themselves manipulated, and she finally turns against Amandara.

glossary.role: Earth Federation captain (Captain, 大佐) of the assault carrier Albion; leads the pursuit of the stolen GP02.
glossary.personality: Grizzled veteran with a commanding presence and keen tactical mind; relies on his own judgement and sense of right and wrong.

glossary.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
glossary.role: SDF-1 Macross, the U.N. Spacy super-dimensional fortress (human flagship).

glossary.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
glossary.role: U.N. Spacy officer (Lieutenant), bridge officer/coordinator of the SDF-1 Macross.
glossary.personality: Stern, by-the-book, duty-bound officer with little humor at work; softens and grows close to Hikaru.

glossary.role: Seat no. 3 and de facto leader of Poseidal's Thirteen, the highest-ranking officer after Poseidal; rebels against Poseidal with his own fleet (the Giwaza fleet) and is killed in the final battle.
glossary.personality: Capable, cold, calculating and ambitious; uses and discards people, including his lover Nei Mo Han; a political schemer.

glossary.role: ACE2 heroine; Ensign in Tak's squad, pilot of the red Gun Ark; goes missing at Torrington Base, reappears with the Rainen Project in the Buster Ark, later rejoins Tak.
glossary.personality: Cool and reserved ('defrosting ice queen' in flashbacks); deeply bonded with Tak.

glossary.series: Super Dimension Fortress Macross: Do You Remember Love?
glossary.role: Protagonist of Macross DYRL; former civilian stunt flyer turned U.N. Spacy VF-1 Valkyrie pilot (Skull Squadron).
glossary.personality: Hot-headed, impulsive and stubborn young pilot who grows into responsibility; caught in a love triangle between Minmay and Misa.

glossary.note: army/MS rank; a ship's captain (艦長) is also Captain
Op 01 uses 'unit' for mecha in general, 'machine' when the speaker is the developer

40.speaker: Misa Hayase
40.evidence: brief: 'こちらデルタ１。' (Delta 1 is Misa's callsign in Macross DYRL); confirmed by brief63124#2

context_before.jp: <op()><sp(20)>艦長、監視衛星からの連絡です！<ab(500)>

<sp(20)>主砲ビームは、月軌道内２８万キロ地点で
宇宙船らしき物を撃破。<ab(700)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>さらに後続の宇宙船多数、急速接近中！<ab(900)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>ふ、ふふふふふふ……ははははははは！<ab(700)><ed()>

<op()><sp(20)>ハメられたんだよ、我々は！
ブービートラップに！<ab(500)>

<sp(20)>この船は異星人がしかけた、
ブービートラップだったんだよ！<ab(800)>
<sp(20)>おそらく、敵対する宇宙人が現われると<ab(0)>

<sp(20)>自動防衛システムが作動するように
プログラムしてあったのだろう。<ab(700)>

<sp(20)>おかげで我々は、異星人同士の戦争に
巻き込まれるハメになったわけだ！<ab(700)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>高速で接近する機影があります！<ab(300)>

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>あいつは…！　来たか、マリナ！<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>That machine...! You came, Marina!<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.notes: Tak recognizes Marina piloting the Buster Ark.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>……今回は護衛つきのようですね。<ab(1000)><ed()>
rows.en:
<op()><sp(20)>...It seems you have an escort
this time.<ab(1000)><ed()>
rows.notes: Marina Carson observing Tak and allied forces.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>私がやらなくては…<ab(1000)><ed()>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>I must do this...<ab(1000)><ed()>
rows.notes: Marina speaking to herself.

rows.jp:
<op()><sp(20)>マリナ、聞こえているか？
もう一度話をしよう。<ab(1200)><ed()>
rows.en:
<op()><sp(20)>Marina, can you hear me?
Let us talk one more time.<ab(1200)><ed()>
rows.notes: Tak Kepford trying to communicate with Marina.

rows.jp:
<op()><sp(20)>……聞かないなら
力づくしかないな。<ab(700)><ed()>
rows.en:
<op()><sp(20)>...If you will not listen,
I have to use force.<ab(700)><ed()>
rows.notes: Tak resolving to disable the Buster Ark.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>ポセイダルの増援！？<ab(300)><ed()>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>Poseidal reinforcements!?<ab(300)><ed()>
rows.notes: Allied pilot / Tak reaction to Poseidal forces.

rows.jp:
<op()><sp(20)>よいか！　あの機体を捕らえ、
ギワザ様に献上するのだ！<ab(600)><ed()>
rows.en:
<op()><sp(20)>Listen up! Capture that machine
and present it to Lord Giwaza!<ab(600)><ed()>
rows.notes: Poseidal commander ordering capture of the Buster Ark.

rows.jp:
<op()><sp(20)>やはりポセイダル軍は、
あいつを狙っている…<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.en:
<op()><sp(20)>The Poseidal forces really are
after her...<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.notes: Tak realizing Giwaza's intent to capture Marina.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>逃がすな！　追えーっ！<ab(200)><ed()>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>Do not let it escape! Pursue it!<ab(200)><ed()>
rows.notes: Poseidal pilot pursuing Buster Ark.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>ギワザめ…あの機体を利用する気か！<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.en:
<op()><sp(20)>Damn Giwaza... He intends to use
that machine!<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.notes: Tak recognizing Giwaza's ambitions.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>もう、俺には止められないのか…<ab(800)><ed()>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>Can I not stop her anymore...?<ab(800)><ed()>
rows.notes: Tak lamenting his inability to reach Marina.

rows.jp:
<op()><sp(20)>周辺地域を制圧した。
各機、全速でマクロスへ向かえ！<ab(600)><ed()>
rows.en:
<op()><sp(20)>The surrounding area is secured.
All units, head to Macross at top speed!<ab(600)><ed()>
rows.notes: Allied commander ordering rendezvous at SDF-1 Macross.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>やはりこの惑星に隠れておったのか……<ab(600)>
rows.en:
<op()><sp(20)>So it was hiding on this planet
after all...<ab(600)>
rows.notes: Zentradi commander detecting the SDF-1 Macross.

rows.jp:
<sp(20)>全艦に発令！
インファイトゾーンに突入する！<ab(900)><ed()>
rows.en:
<sp(20)>Order to all ships!
Charge into the close-combat zone!<ab(900)><ed()>
rows.notes: Zentradi commander ordering fleet to engage Macross.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>６時の方向に熱源を確認！<ab(400)><ed()>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>Heat source detected at 6 o'clock!<ab(400)><ed()>
rows.notes: Bridge operator detecting thermal signature.

rows.jp: <on()><sp(20)>主砲が、作動します！<ab(0)><off()>
rows.en: <on()><sp(20)>The main cannon is activating!<ab(0)><off()>
rows.notes: Bridge operator warning that the main cannon is firing automatically.

rows.jp:
<op(40,1)><sp(2)>こちら<im(1)>デルタ１。
<im(2)>回線を開いてください。
rows.en:
<op(40,1)><sp(2)>This is <im(1)>Delta 1.
<im(2)>Please open a channel.
rows.notes: Misa Hayase (portrait 40) opening comm line in tactical briefing.

rows.jp:
<op(40,1)><sp(2)>先ほどの戦闘における主砲の発射で、
<im(6)>衛星<im(8)>軌道に展開する#c[BE5050]異星人の艦隊#cに、
本艦の位置を察知されました。
rows.en:
<op(40,1)><sp(2)>The earlier main cannon fire alerted
the <im(6)>forces in <im(8)>orbit, the #c[BE5050]alien fleet#c,
to this ship's position.
rows.notes: Misa Hayase explaining how the booby trap gave away Macross's location.

rows.jp:
<op(40,1)><sp(2)>現在、本艦は敵の攻撃を受けています。
<im(3)>ただちに#c[F07141]マクロス<im(5)>の防衛#cに<tr(1)>入ってください。
rows.en:
<op(40,1)><sp(2)>This ship is currently under enemy attack.
<im(3)>Please proceed with the #c[F07141]defense <im(5)>of Macross#c<tr(1)>
immediately.
rows.notes: Misa Hayase issuing defense orders. Tokens match exact sequence.

rows.jp:
<op(40,1)><sp(2)>こち<im(10)>らからは、<of(1)>#c[5E8FD8]スカル小隊#cの発艦を
許可します。
rows.en:
<op(40,1)><sp(2)>From our end, <im(10)>we have <of(1)>authorized
the launch of #c[5E8FD8]Skull Squadron#c.
rows.notes: Misa Hayase authorizing Skull Squadron sortie.

rows.jp: マクロスの撃沈
rows.en: Destruction of Macross
rows.notes: Mission loss condition.

rows.jp: マクロス
rows.en: Macross
rows.notes: Target name.

rows.jp:
<op()><sp(20)>本艦は現在、異星人と交戦中である！
これは演習ではない。<ab(200)>
rows.en:
<op()><sp(20)>This ship is engaging alien forces!
This is not a drill.<ab(200)>
rows.notes: Global ship-wide broadcast.

rows.jp: <sp(20)>繰り返す、これは演習ではない！<ab(300)>
rows.en: <sp(20)>I repeat, this is not a drill!<ab(300)>
rows.notes: Global broadcast continuation.

rows.jp:
<sp(20)>敵の数が多すぎて、
攻撃を完全に防ぐことはできません。<ab(400)>
rows.en:
<sp(20)>There are too many enemies to fully
defend against every attack.<ab(400)>
rows.notes: Global / Misa situation update.

rows.jp:
<sp(20)>可能な限り早く敵を排除して、
本艦の損傷を最小限に留めてください！<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.en:
<sp(20)>Eliminate the enemy quickly and keep
this ship's damage to a minimum!<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.notes: Global / Misa order to player units.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>こいつらがシナプス艦長の言ってた…<ab(0)><ed()>
rows.en:
<op()><sp(20)>So these are the ones
Capt. Sinapus spoke of...<ab(0)><ed()>
rows.notes: Allied pilot recalling Sinapus's briefing on Zentradi.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>ゼントラーディとか言う異星人か！？<ab(400)><ed()>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>The aliens called Zentradi!?<ab(400)><ed()>
rows.notes: Pilot identifying Zentradi forces.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>とにかく、敵なのは確かだ！　迎撃するぞ！<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.en:
<op()><sp(20)>Either way, they are enemies!
Intercept them!<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.notes: Squad leader / pilot ordering interception.

rows.jp:
<op()><sp(20)>周辺の市街地は危険だ。
市民を艦内に避難させろ！<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.en:
<op()><sp(20)>The city area is in danger.
Evacuate civilians into the ship!<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.notes: Global / Macross officer ordering South Ataria civilian evacuation.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>フォッカー少佐！<ab(100)><ed()>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>Major Focker!<ab(100)><ed()>
rows.notes: Capt. Burning or allied officer addressing Roy Focker.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>よお、大尉！　今回はスマンな。<ab(200)><ed()>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>Hey, Captain! Sorry about this.<ab(200)><ed()>
rows.notes: Roy Focker greeting Captain Burning.

rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>Major, who is he?<ab(200)><ed()>
rows.notes: Burning noticing Hikaru Ichijyo in formation.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>こいつは一条輝。　見てのとおり腕は確かだ。<ab(200)><ed()>
rows.en:
<op()><sp(20)>This is Hikaru Ichijyo.
As you can see, his skills are solid.<ab(200)><ed()>
rows.notes: Focker introducing Hikaru.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>だから、俺は民間人だって……<ab(0)><ed()>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>Like I said, I am a civilian...<ab(0)><ed()>
rows.notes: Hikaru complaining that he is not a soldier.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>輝さんだっけ、あきらめなよ。<ab(300)><ed()>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>Was it Hikaru? Just give up.<ab(300)><ed()>
rows.notes: Kaine Wakaba (Dragonar) giving sympathetic advice.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>俺たちも同じこと言ってたしな……<ab(300)><ed()>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>We used to say the exact same thing...<ab(300)><ed()>
rows.notes: Tap Oceano / Light Newman chiming in.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>俺なんか、ほんとはコックだったのに……<ab(100)><ed()>
rows.en:
<op()><sp(20)>I was actually
supposed to be a cook...<ab(100)><ed()>
rows.notes: Akito Tenkawa (Nadesico) grumbling about his original trade.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>無駄話はそこまでだ！　来やがったぞ！<ab(400)><ed()>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>Enough chatter! Here they come!<ab(400)><ed()>
rows.notes: Burning cutting off the banter as enemy arrives.

rows.jp:
<op()><sp(20)>Ｄブロックに損傷。
こちらもそう長くは持ちません！<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.en:
<op()><sp(20)>Damage to D-Block.
We cannot hold out much longer either!<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.notes: Macross bridge operator damage report.

rows.jp:
<op()><sp(20)>損傷箇所拡大。
このままでは危険です、急いで！<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.en:
<op()><sp(20)>Damage spreading.
This is dangerous at this rate, hurry!<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.notes: Bridge operator urging quick action.

rows.jp:
<op()><sp(20)>左舷Ｆブロック、エンジンブロック損傷。
艦長……！<ab(300)><ed()>
rows.en:
<op()><sp(20)>Port F-Block and engine block damaged.
Captain...!<ab(300)><ed()>
rows.notes: Bridge operator / Misa reporting critical damage.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>ここで沈むわけには……！<ab(300)><ed()>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>We cannot go down here...!<ab(300)><ed()>
rows.notes: Captain Global determined.

rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>All hands, abandon ship...<ab(0)><ed()>
rows.notes: Global order on mission failure.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>マクロスが撃沈！<ab(600)><ed()>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>Macross has been destroyed!<ab(600)><ed()>
rows.notes: Failure notification line.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>なんということだ…<ab(800)><ed()>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>How could this happen...<ab(800)><ed()>
rows.notes: Capt. Sinapus reaction to Macross sinking.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>未確認機の増援を確認！<ab(300)><ed()>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>Unidentified reinforcements detected!<ab(300)><ed()>
rows.notes: Bridge operator detecting wave.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>しゃーないなあ、行きますか……<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>No choice then, guess I'll go...<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.notes: Casual tone, likely Focker or Dragonar pilot.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>未確認機、さらに来ます！<ab(300)><ed()>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>More unidentified units incoming!<ab(300)><ed()>
rows.notes: Bridge operator warning.

rows.jp:
<op()><sp(20)>そこのバルキリー、しっかりしなさい！
戦争なのよ！<ab(300)><ed()>
rows.en:
<op()><sp(20)>Valkyrie over there, get a grip!
This is a war!<ab(300)><ed()>
rows.notes: Misa Hayase scolding civilian Hikaru Ichijyo.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>誰です、あのオバサン？<ab(200)><ed()>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>Who is that old lady?<ab(200)><ed()>
rows.notes: Hikaru asking Focker about Misa (the famous 'obasan' line).
Misa sputtering in shock and rage.

rows.jp:
<op()><sp(20)>はははは！　マクロスのオペレータ、
早瀬未沙中尉だ！<ab(200)><ed()>
rows.en:
<op()><sp(20)>Hahaha! That is Macross's controller,
Lieutenant Misa Hayase!<ab(200)><ed()>
rows.notes: Focker laughing and introducing Misa.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>輝から見ればオバサンか、ふははは！<ab(100)><ed()>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>An old lady to you, huh? Hahaha!<ab(100)><ed()>
rows.notes: Focker teasing.

rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>...Major Focker!<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.notes: Misa indignant at Focker.

rows.jp:
<op()><sp(20)>なあ輝、こうして並んで飛んでると
昔を思い出すな。<ab(400)><ed()>
rows.en:
<op()><sp(20)>Hey Hikaru, flying side by side like
this brings back old times.<ab(400)><ed()>
rows.notes: Focker reminiscing about airshows.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>そんなのん気なこと言ってる場合ですか？<ab(400)><ed()>
rows.en:
<op()><sp(20)>Is this really the time
to be talking so carefree?<ab(400)><ed()>
rows.notes: Hikaru retorting in combat.

rows.jp:
<op()><sp(20)>俺が前で、お前はいつも
後ろをちょろちょろ飛んでたっけ。<ab(300)><ed()>
rows.en:
<op()><sp(20)>I was out front, and you were always
buzzing around right behind me.<ab(300)><ed()>
rows.notes: Focker teasing Hikaru about formation flying.

rows.jp:
<op()><sp(20)>言ったでしょ、
いつまでも後ろじゃないって！<ab(400)><ed()>
rows.en:
<op()><sp(20)>I told you, I am not staying
behind you forever!<ab(400)><ed()>
rows.notes: Hikaru asserting himself.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>敵の増援、止まりました！<ab(300)><ed()>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>Enemy reinforcements have stopped!<ab(300)><ed()>
rows.notes: Bridge operator announcement.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>全機、残った機体を掃討せよ！<ab(400)><ed()>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>All units, sweep the remaining forces!<ab(400)><ed()>
rows.notes: Burning / Focker command.

rows.jp:
<op()><sp(20)>も、目標多数接近します！
すごい数です……！<ab(400)><ed()>
rows.en:
<op()><sp(20)>M-Multiple targets approaching!
There are so many of them...!<ab(400)><ed()>
rows.notes: Bridge operator detecting mass Zentradi force.

rows.jp:
<op()><sp(20)>ちくしょー、死ぬ時は親父みたいに
スタント中にって決めてたのに！<ab(300)><ed()>
rows.en:
<op()><sp(20)>Damn it, I decided that when I die,
it would be in a stunt like my dad!<ab(300)><ed()>
rows.notes: Hikaru complaining about dying in military combat.

rows.jp:
<op()><sp(20)>弱音を吐くな！
片っ端から落とすぞ！<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.en:
<op()><sp(20)>Stop whining!
Shoot down every last one of them!<ab(500)><ed()>
rows.notes: Roy Focker encouraging Hikaru.

rows.jp:
<op()><sp(20)>これ以上は艦がもたん！
空間転移に入る！<ab(400)><ed()>
rows.en:
<op()><sp(20)>The ship cannot take any more!
Initiating space fold!<ab(400)><ed()>
rows.notes: Global deciding on emergency fold escape.

rows.jp:
<op()><sp(20)>フォールドシステムを？
まだテストも済んでいません！<ab(300)><ed()>
rows.en:
<op()><sp(20)>The fold system?
It has not even been tested yet!<ab(300)><ed()>
rows.notes: Misa Hayase protesting untested fold.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>確かにリスクは大きい。<ab(100)>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>The risk is certainly high.<ab(100)>
rows.notes: Global acknowledging risk.

rows.jp:
<sp(20)>しかし、ここでとどまっていては
やられるだけだ！<ab(400)><ed()>
rows.en:
<sp(20)>However, if we stay here,
we will only be destroyed!<ab(400)><ed()>
rows.notes: Global continuing rationale.

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>でも、異星人のシステムですよ？<ab(200)><ed()>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>But it is an alien system!<ab(200)><ed()>
rows.notes: Bridge operator objecting.

rows.jp:
<op()><sp(20)>やってもみないで
あきらめられては困るな！<ab(300)><ed()>
rows.en:
<op()><sp(20)>We cannot just give up
without even trying!<ab(300)><ed()>
rows.notes: Global pressing forward.

rows.jp:
<op()><sp(20)>フォールドシステムスタンバイ！
フォールド目標、月の裏側！<ab(700)><ed()>
rows.en:
<op()><sp(20)>Fold system on standby!
Fold target, dark side of the Moon!<ab(700)><ed()>
rows.notes: Misa / bridge operator executing fold countdown.

rows.jp:
<on()><sp(20)>輝！　何でお前がいるんだ？
お前、いつから戦闘機乗りになったんだ？<ab(0)><off()>
rows.en:
<on()><sp(20)>Hikaru! What are you doing here?
When did you become a fighter pilot?<ab(0)><off()>
rows.notes: Focker spotting Hikaru during battle.

rows.jp: <on()><sp(20)>冗談！　誰が戦闘機乗りなんかに！<ab(0)><off()>
rows.en:
<on()><sp(20)>No way! Who wants
to be a fighter pilot!?<ab(0)><off()>
rows.notes: Hikaru vehemently denying he chose this.

rows.jp:

report.translator_summary: Translated op20_02 (80 rows), spanning the arrival of Marina in the Buster Ark, Giwaza's forces attempting to capture it, Misa Hayase's Phase 2 tactical briefing (portrait 40, Delta 1), and Phase 2 battle where Zentradi overwhelm Macross. Captures the iconic banter where Hikaru calls Misa 'obasan', Focker's amusement, the fellow reluctant civilian pilots (Dragonar trio, Akito), and Global's desperate gamble to execute an untested space fold.
uncertainties: m6202#18 and m6202#19: identified speakers as Dragonar squad (Tap/Light) and Akito Tenkawa ('was supposed to be a cook') reacting to Hikaru's civilian status based on cross-series character backstories.
m6202#62: Zentradi commander line ('A micron planet, is it...?') assigned as Britai/Exsedol watching Earth after Macross folds.
